title: Last time playing with Lorenzo Tio, and the Tio family
summary: Picou recalls a party in Los Angeles where he last played with Tio, and describes old Lorenzo Tio as a Mexican-born teacher who used a baton.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: The last time I played with Lorenzo. Yeah. In Los Angeles, California. And they gave a party for me. In Los Angeles, California. in Los Angeles, California. They gave a party for me in Los Angeles, California. I forgot the name of the cabaret, wherever it was. And I'm telling you, we had a time that night. That's the time they made me sing Creole song. There were a couple of the Tios, weren't there? Was there a Lorenzo Tio? Lorenzo? Papa Tio. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Do you know where they came from? Oh, the old man Lorenzo Tio, he was from a Spanish place. Oh, Lord, I forgot. But he was a great musician. You know, he might have come from Mexico. Yeah, Mexico. Mexico. Mexico, that's it, Mexico. And how did the old man play, when you talk about Lorenzo Tio, there was Lorenzo Tio Jr., wasn't there, the young man? That's right. And then the old man. Yeah, the old man. Did he play dance jobs too, the old man, or just teach? No, he didn't care about, but he was a great teacher. Oh, yeah. He used to, he used to be the man that used the baton in a big band. You know? He used the band with that stick. You know what I'm saying? We call that baton.
